checks.explanation: Well ahead of the 5-year window, Google's Quantum Echoes algorithm (2025-2026) demonstrated verifiable quantum advantage running 13,000x faster than classical supercomputers on a real molecular-structure-measurement task, and IonQ/Ansys reported a 36-qubit medical device simulation outperforming classical HPC by 12%, both genuinely useful practical computations superior to classical methods.

The predicted 2-to-3-year window (through roughly 2027-2028) has not fully elapsed as of August 2026; humanoid robot deployment is scaling fast (from ~3,000 units in 2024 to ~50,000 expected operating commercially in 2026) but manufacturers still describe an operational ceiling of 3-4 hours and dexterity limits, short of a definitive breakthrough 'magical moment.'

sources.title: What Are Humanoid Robots? The State of Robotics in 2026
